# Shift Swap Board — Product Requirements

This document describes the first release of Shift Swap Board for the retail scheduling team.

## Goals
- Give the retail scheduling team one screen for daily work.
- Replace the current spreadsheet with an auditable record.
- Reduce the time to answer a customer request.

options.extraInstructions: Keep the plan small: one sprint and at most five tasks.

project.name: Shift Swap Board
project.description: Retail shift swap requests, approvals and audit in one board, replacing the scheduling spreadsheet.

sprints.name: Sprint 1 - Swap Requests Live
sprints.goal: Ship shift swap request, approval and audit for the retail scheduling team.

epics.title: Swap Request Intake
epics.description: Capture swap requests from the schedule board with validation and manager notification.

epics.title: Approval and Audit Log
epics.description: Approve or decline requests and record every decision in an immutable audit trail.

epics.title: Coverage Visibility
epics.description: Surface coverage gaps and schedule impact so managers can decide quickly.

items.title: Request a swap from the schedule board
items.description: An employee selects one of their own future shifts and a preferred replacement; the request is validated before it is saved.
acceptanceCriteria: An employee can submit a swap request for one of their own future shifts.
A request cannot be created for a past shift or one already swapped.

items.title: Approve or decline a swap request
items.description: Managers see the request, the affected shifts and the coverage impact, then approve or decline with a reason.
acceptanceCriteria: A manager can approve or decline an open request in a single action.
Declining a request requires a short written reason.

items.title: Audit log for every swap decision
items.description: Each state change stores actor, timestamp and previous and new state so the record replaces the spreadsheet.
acceptanceCriteria: Every decision appears in the audit log with actor and UTC timestamp.
A log entry cannot be edited or deleted from the interface.

items.title: Show coverage gaps on the day view
items.description: The day view marks shifts left uncovered by an approved swap so managers can backfill before the shift starts.
acceptanceCriteria: Approved swaps that leave a shift uncovered are flagged on the day view.
Flags clear automatically once the shift is reassigned.

items.title: Spike: confirm payroll export for swapped hours
items.description: Investigate how swapped hours must be exported to payroll and record the findings for the next release.
acceptanceCriteria: Findings are documented, including the required payroll fields.
An implementation recommendation is agreed with the scheduling team.

assumptions: Managers already use one shared schedule that the board can read from.
Employees sign in with the existing single sign-on provider.
Swap requests cover published shifts in the next four weeks only.
The retail scheduling team supplies anonymised sample data for testing.
Approved swaps are applied to the schedule by the existing scheduler, not by this release.
risks: Shift data may sit in a scheduler without a public API, which would delay swap intake.
Payroll rules for swapped hours are unclear and may change the export design.
Managers may keep the spreadsheet if the board is slower to load.
Audit log retention rules are not yet confirmed with the compliance team.
